name: Lesotho
summary: The Administration of Estates and Inheritance Act 2024 (in force 2 April 2024) replaced the Wills Ordinance and Law of Inheritance Act, and is reported to let people draft wills freely. Customary law still has a place for customary estates. Trusts and foundations were not sourced.
family_claims: The 2024 Act expands spouse inheritance rights for customary marriages (ss. 71-72, reported); whether it gives a court-ordered family provision was not confirmed.
trust_note: Trusts: not sourced; 'yes' assumes Roman-Dutch/common-law trusts; unverified. No private-foundation law found.
open_questions: Text of the 2024 Act not read (site blocked); reported freedom of testation and family rights need checking.

Hague Trusts Convention: The HCCH status table (checked 2026-10-16) lists 14 Contracting Parties; this country is not one of them and no UK, Dutch or Chinese extension covers it, so the 1985 Convention is not in force here.
Domestic trusts: likely available under the inherited common-law or Roman-Dutch tradition, but no statute or official source was read; confirm before marking yes.

sources.title: Administration of Estates and Inheritance Act 2024 (Act 2 of 2024)
HCCH status table: Convention of 1 July 1985 on the Law Applicable to Trusts and on their Recognition
